name: GhostProgress
description: Headless determinate progress indicator with an indeterminate fallback. useGhostProgress owns progressbar semantics, clamping, and value text; GhostProgress is the thin unstyled element. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name applied as aria-label. role=progressbar is nameFrom author; contents are presentational and cannot name the widget.

props.name: max
props.description: Exclusive upper bound of the range. Defaults to 100 (ARIA progressbar valuemax), not HTML progress's 1. Invalid values fall back to 100.

props.name: value
props.description: Current progress in the same unit as max. Omit or pass null for the indeterminate fallback. Non-finite numbers are treated as unknown. Finite values are clamped to [0, max].

props.name: valueText
props.description: Accessible value text (aria-valuetext) for determinate instances. When omitted, the default is the rounded percent. Ignored while indeterminate.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The progressbar div. data-state=indeterminate is present only while the value is unknown.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The fill. Determinate width is an inline inline-size percentage so headless consumers get a functional bar without the theme.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Value is omitted, null, or non-finite. aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext are omitted.
